ai.title: Add incremental chat completion traces
ai.summary: SDK `RunState` gains `traceSessionId` (UUID), threaded through `run.ts` and `extraCodebuffMetadata` as `trace_session_id`. New BigQuery `chat_completion_traces` table stores `ChatCompletionTraceRow` with delta hashing (`delta_message_hashes`, `common_prefix_length`, `cache_hit`, `full_snapshot`) and JSON-stringified payloads. `setupBigQuery` auto-creates the table with monthly partitioning on `created_at` and clustering on `user_id`, `trace_session_id`, `trace_lineage_id`. CLI `run-state-storage.ts` imports `randomUUID` for state persistence alignment.

eli5.text: The CLI now records a detailed, step-by-step log of each conversation it has with an AI model and stores it in a database. This means developers can later look back at exactly what was sent and received at each point, including which parts were reused from a fast cache versus freshly generated. Each conversation is grouped under a unique ID so related steps can be connected together. The logging only captures data when the app sends these new trace records, so you would only notice it if the application was updated to use this new tracing feature.

ai.title: Freebuff hard-blocks VPN, proxy, and Tor traffic in free mode
ai.summary: Freebuff introduces a hard-block tier for free mode that rejects VPN, proxy, Tor, and residential-proxy traffic outright instead of downgrading it to limited mode. The new common/src/util/freebuff-privacy.ts exports FREEBUFF_HARD_BLOCKED_PRIVACY_SIGNALS and isFreebuffHardBlockedPrivacySignal, and shouldHardBlockFreeModeAccess in web/src/server/free-mode-country.ts treats Cloudflare Tor country 'T1' and anonymous_network signals as hard blocks. The session handlers in web/src/app/api/v1/freebuff/session/_handlers.ts and the chat completions route in web/src/app/api/v1/chat/completions/_post.ts now return a 403 country_blocked response and terminate the session for hard-blocked requests. Hosting, relay, anonymous, and service signals remain limited rather than hard-blocked, and the CLI surfaces the country_blocked reason in the waiting room screen with a VPN/proxy/Tor-specific message.
ai.evidence: Commit a3dbf723 adds common/src/util/freebuff-privacy.ts exporting FREEBUFF_HARD_BLOCKED_PRIVACY_SIGNALS (vpn, proxy, tor, res_proxy) and isFreebuffHardBlockedPrivacySignal, plus shouldHardBlockFreeModeAccess in web/src/server/free-mode-country.ts (hard-blocks Cloudflare Tor country 'T1' and anonymous_network with a hard-blocked signal); _handlers.ts and _post.ts call shouldHardBlockFreeModeAccess to return country_blocked 403 responses, and tests assert 'blocks VPN/proxy privacy signals before joining the queue', 'blocks Cloudflare Tor before joining the queue', 'returns country_blocked on GET for VPN/proxy privacy signals', 'returns country_blocked on GET for Cloudflare Tor', and 'hard-blocks Cloudflare Tor without falling back to IP geo'.
ai.migration: Freebuff users on VPN, proxy, or Tor must disable that traffic and restart Freebuff to use free mode; hosting-only and relay signals continue to work in limited mode without changes.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show which ipinfo privacy-signal source populates the vpn/proxy/tor/res_proxy signals for non-Cloudflare requests, nor whether the hard-block list is configurable beyond code.

changes.what: New module defining FREEBUFF_HARD_BLOCKED_PRIVACY_SIGNALS and isFreebuffHardBlockedPrivacySignal for classifying vpn, proxy, tor, and res_proxy signals.
Adds shouldHardBlockFreeModeAccess that hard-blocks Cloudflare Tor country 'T1' and anonymous_network with a hard-blocked signal, while hosting and relay remain limited.
Session POST and GET handlers now check shouldHardBlockFreeModeAccess and return a 403 country_blocked response, ending any existing session.
Chat completions route checks shouldHardBlockFreeModeAccess and rejects hard-blocked free-mode requests with a 403 country_blocked response.
Waiting room screen renders the country_blocked reason with a VPN/proxy/Tor-specific message sourced from formatFreebuffHardBlockedPrivacySignals.
Send-message error handler uses getFreeModeUnavailableErrorMessage for free mode errors instead of the generic FREE_MODE_UNAVAILABLE_MESSAGE.

ai.title: Freebuff 0.0.94 released with proxy support and VPN blocking
ai.summary: Version 0.0.94 rolls up the day's changes: the CLI API client now respects `HTTPS_PROXY`/`HTTP_PROXY` env vars (and honors `proxy: null` to disable), the completions API hard-blocks VPN/proxy/Tor requests via `FREEBUFF_HARD_BLOCKED_PRIVACY_SIGNALS` returning 403 `free_mode_unavailable`, access tier analytics were added to completion events, and incremental chat completion traces now stream UUID-tagged `trace_session_id` rows into a BigQuery `chat_completion_traces` table with delta hashing. Bundled alongside the DeepSeek session trace exporter script and a simplified /live stats view. The release bump touches only `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` (0.0.93 -> 0.0.94).
ai.evidence: Modified `freebuff/cli/release/package.json` bumps the `version` field from `0.0.93` to `0.0.94`; this is a release-bump commit within the 0.0.93->0.0.94 release sequence including proxy support, VPN/proxy blocking, free tier analytics, and incremental chat completion traces.

eli5.text: Freebuff 0.0.94 adds proper proxy server support and blocks traffic coming through VPNs, proxies, and Tor networks to prevent abuse of free compute credits. The command-line tool can now route its internet traffic through your corporate or local proxy by reading standard HTTPS_PROXY/HTTP_PROXY environment variables, and you can turn this off by passing proxy: null when building the API client. The waiting room that greets you while you're placed into a free AI compute slot now shows clear labels like 'VPN or Tor' instead of vague messaging whenever your network is flagged as anonymized. A new analytics system tracks which access tier (free vs. paid) you're using during chat completion requests, giving better insight into usage patterns. The SDK now attaches a unique trace session ID to every conversation run and logs detailed chat completion traces to BigQuery, including cached-response detection and prefix-delta hashing, which helps debug and reconstruct multi-turn sessions later. Finally, a new export script lets the team reconstruct full DeepSeek free-mode conversations from raw database rows by grouping requests by their client ID and pulling the highest-context message as the conversation snapshot.

ai.title: Onboard page handles missing CLI auth code
ai.summary: Added explicit 'missing' status handling for CLI auth code resolution in the onboarding flow. Web and Codebuff surfaces now render a static expired-link card instead of proceeding with an undefined token. Includes structured logging of auth code metadata on the Web surface to aid debugging.

eli5.text: When you open the browser login page during setup and the terminal never sent over a valid login code (or it already expired), the page now shows a clear 'link expired' message instead of freezing or trying to continue with a broken connection. This affects anyone running the setup flow through the terminal command, and you'd notice the helpful card telling you to return to your terminal and restart the process rather than seeing a loading spinner or error. The change is live today across both product surfaces.
